name: @kernable/sdk
description: kernable SDK for TypeScript: event-sourced business logic in TypeScript on the kernable kernel
author: kernable

scripts.build: rm -rf dist proto && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && mkdir -p proto/kernable/v1 && cp ../../proto/kernable/v1/kernable.proto proto/kernable/v1/ && rm -rf kit && mkdir -p kit/test && cp -R ../../kits/typescript/src ../../kits/typescript/example ../../kits/typescript/README.md ../../kits/typescript/package.json kit/ && cp -R ../../kits/typescript/test/unit kit/test/ && cp -R ../../kits/fixtures kit/fixtures && cp ../../kits/LICENSE kit/LICENSE
